headline: CRITICAL METALS CLEARS EUROPEAN LITHIUM COURT HURDLE — $835M Lithium Scheme Through Second Hearing, Implements November 5
snippet: Critical Metals Corp.'s $835M acquisition of European Lithium cleared its second scheme of arrangement court hearing on October 26, following shareholder approval on October 22. The scheme is now on track for implementation on November 5, combining the companies' critical minerals assets including the Wolfsberg lithium project in Austria.

headline: ASX LITHIUM STOCKS ROCKET MONDAY: PILBARA +8%, LIONTOWN +6% — Weeks of Selling Reversed as Sector Sentiment Pivots
snippet: Pilbara Minerals surged 8% and Liontown Resources jumped 6% on the ASX in Monday trading, reversing weeks of heavy selling pressure in the lithium sector. The sharp bounce coincided with broader market recovery and growing speculation that the worst of the sector's pricing correction may be approaching its floor.

headline: BENZINGA: NEWMONT'S OUTPERFORMANCE EXPOSES EXTREME SHORT IN GOLD EQUITIES — Contrarian Setup Builds as Equity-Metal Gap Widens
snippet: Benzinga analysis finds extreme short positioning in gold-related equities despite Newmont Corporation's consistent sector outperformance while gold holds near $4,000. The analysis notes that Newmont's resilience has left short sellers exposed in a pattern historically preceding sharp covering rallies.

headline: GOLD DEFENDS $4,000 WITH FOMC 48 HOURS OUT — Market Prices 84% Hold; Warsh Press Conference Is the Key Variable
snippet: Gold is holding the $4,000 floor ahead of Wednesday's Federal Reserve decision, with CME FedWatch pricing an 84% probability of a hold. Analysts say Chair Warsh's tone at the press conference — and any signal toward a December pause — is the key catalyst that could push gold back above $4,100.

headline: URANIUM ONE MINING ENGAGES ATHABASCA BASIN SPECIALIST — Adrian Huerta Ruiz Tapped to Advance Saskatchewan Uranium Program
snippet: Vancouver-based Uranium One Mining Corp. has engaged Adrian Huerta Ruiz as technical advisor to guide its Athabasca Basin uranium exploration program. The appointment signals active delineation work in Saskatchewan's premier uranium jurisdiction as spot prices hold above $89/lb.

headline: LME COPPER CLAWS BACK 1.8% TO $14,098 AS INVENTORY BUILD SLOWS — Five-Week Low Looks Like Near-Term Floor
snippet: LME copper bounced 1.8% to $14,098 per metric tonne on Monday as equity markets stabilized and the pace of warehouse inventory builds moderated from recent highs. Analysts are watching $13,925 — the September low — as the key support level if selling resumes ahead of Wednesday's FOMC decision.

headline: CENTERRA GOLD DELIVERS RECORD FREE CASH FLOW IN 2026 — Mount Milligan and Öksüt Margins Expand as Gold Holds Above $4,000
snippet: Centerra Gold (TSX:CG) is generating record free cash flow in fiscal 2026, with Mount Milligan and Öksüt operations delivering expanding margins as gold prices remain elevated. The company's cash generation strength and low relative valuation in the peer group are drawing renewed analyst attention.

headline: OIL, NOT THE FED, DROVE GOLD BELOW $4,100 — Crude's Run to Multi-Year Highs Inflated Hike Bets; New Fed Signals Minimal
snippet: GoldSilver.com analysis argues the October sell-off in gold and silver came primarily from crude oil's surge to multi-year highs inflating inflation expectations — not from new Federal Reserve hawkishness. With the FOMC meeting this week, the oil price trajectory may matter more than the rate decision itself.

headline: URANIUM SPOT ABOVE $89 BUT MINERS 40-50% BELOW RECENT HIGHS — Structural Deficit Narrative Not Yet Reaching Equity Prices
snippet: Despite uranium spot prices holding above $89/lb near multi-decade highs, many junior uranium miners trade 40-50% below recent peak valuations. Analysis examines whether the equity-to-commodity disconnect reflects structural overshooting, equity market de-risking, or a fundamental repricing of development timelines.

headline: HOCHSCHILD MINING CONFIRMS 2026 PRODUCTION ON TRACK — Strong Gold and Silver Prices Offset Rising Cost Pressures Through Q3
snippet: Hochschild Mining has confirmed its full-year 2026 production guidance remains on track following Q3 operations, with strong gold and silver prices helping to offset cost headwinds from higher royalties and currency effects at its Peru and Argentina mines. Full-year target of 300,000-328,000 gold-equivalent ounces stands.
